class.name: GoetheLocaleManager
class.brief_description: Scene node wrapper around Goethe's CLDR-aware localization catalog manager ([code].gtl[/code]).
class.description: [GoetheLocaleManager] manages Goethe [code].gtl[/code] translation catalogs, CLDR plural forms, parameter interpolation, and optional synchronization with [TranslationServer].

method.name: get_locale
method.description: Returns the active Goethe locale code.

method.name: has_key
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param key] exists in the active locale fallback chain.

method.name: has_key_in_locale
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param key] exists specifically in [param locale].

method.name: load_catalog
method.description: Loads a [code].gtl[/code] catalog file from [code]res://[/code], [code]user://[/code], or an absolute path.

method.name: load_from_package
method.description: Loads [code]locales/<locale>.gtl[/code] from inside a compressed [code].gdkg[/code] package.

method.name: set_locale
method.description: Sets the active locale code and emits [signal locale_changed].

method.name: translate
method.description: Translates [param key] using the active locale and fallback chain.

method.name: translate_plural
method.description: Translates [param key] for count [param n] using CLDR plural rules.

method.name: translate_plural_with_params
method.description: Translates [param key] for count [param n] with placeholder substitution from [param params].

method.name: translate_with_params
method.description: Translates [param key] and substitutes [code]{placeholder}[/code] values from [param params].

members.member: When [code]true[/code], automatically tracks [method TranslationServer.get_locale] changes each frame.

signal.name: locale_changed
signal.description: Emitted whenever [method set_locale] changes the active locale.
